g.aria-label: Symbol legend titled 'Statutory tier' for fill color with 5 values: Established Mayoral, Mayoral, Foundation, Agreed, not yet established, Not in a strategic authority
Title text 'England's Strategic Authorities by statutory tier'
g.text: England's Strategic Authorities by statutory tier

g.aria-label: Subtitle text '11 Established Mayoral, 7 Mayoral and 2 Foundation authorities, plus 2 areas agreed but not yet established. * Mayoral tier; inaugural mayoral election not yet held. Sources: English Devolution and Community Empowerment Act 2026; NAO HC 263 (1 July 2026); Rewiring the State Cabinet Statement (31 July 2026). Boundaries: ONS 2013 local authority districts dissolved to authority footprints.'

text.tspan: 11 Established Mayoral, 7 Mayoral and 2 Foundation authorities, plus 2 areas agreed but not yet established.
* Mayoral tier; inaugural mayoral election not yet held.
Sources: English Devolution and Community Empowerment Act 2026; NAO HC 263 (1 July 2026); Rewiring the State Cabinet Statement (31 July 2026).
Boundaries: ONS 2013 local authority districts dissolved to authority footprints.
